title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
Ledvore is an Indian-Irish engineering company working with clients across Ireland, Europe and the US in automotive, medtech and industrial manufacturing. Our engineering hub is in Coimbatore.

**Please read before applying**

Strong spoken English is the primary requirement for this role. You will be on calls with European engineers daily, asking and answering technical questions directly. We need someone who has already worked in an English-speaking environment — with international clients, an overseas parent company, or a global team.

**The role**

We are hiring an Electrical Design Engineer dedicated to electrical schematics for special purpose machines and automation systems.

You will work alongside our client’s electrical lead, who will provide templates, BOMs and oversight. What we need from you is the ability to take that input and complete the schematics correctly and independently — reading component data sheets, chasing down the answers you need, and asking the right questions when something isn’t clear.

**What you’ll own**

* Complete electrical schematics in EPLAN Electric P8, from template and BOM through to issued drawings
* Reading and interpreting component data sheets drives, PLCs, safety relays, sensors, contactors, motor starters
* Panel layouts, terminal plans, cable schedules and wiring diagrams
* Device tagging, parts database and macro work to the client’s standards
* Generating and checking BOMs against the schematics
* Raising technical queries directly with the client’s engineers and closing them out

**What we need**

* Excellent spoken and written English, with proven experience working in an English-speaking environment
* 8-12 years in electrical schematic design for machines, panels or automation systems
* Strong EPLAN Electric P8. If your background is AutoCAD Electrical or SEE Electrical and you are confident converting, we will consider you
* Genuine data-sheet literacy — you can size and specify from a manufacturer datasheet without being walked through it
* Self-directed. You will have oversight, but nobody will be checking every line
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering

**Nice to have**

* IEC 60204-1 and machinery safety experience
* CE marking exposure
* Safety circuit design to ISO 13849 (e-stops, safety relays, PL ratings)
* VFD, servo drive and motor control schematics
* Experience with European clients or standards

**What you get**

* Direct client exposure — you speak to the engineers using your drawings
* Real ownership from day one

title: PPC Expert
description:
About Backdropsource

Backdropsource is a fast-growing global e-commerce brand delivering custom-printed backdrops and fabrics to customers across North America and Europe.

About the Role

We’re hiring for two positions, a Senior PPC Expert and a PPC Expert (Mid-Level), to run, optimize, and scale our paid acquisition engine. Both are hands-on roles: you’ll plan, run, and optimize campaigns end-to-end across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other platforms, with a direct line to revenue and ROAS, not just spend management.

Location: Coimbatore (in office)

Department: Performance Marketing

Compensation: Industry standard

Mandatory: Hands-on Shopify e-commerce experience. Bonus if you have B2B experience as well.

What We’re Looking For (both roles)

• 5+ years of hands-on PPC experience, including running paid campaigns for a Shopify e-commerce store

• Proven track record of managing significant ad spend profitably across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads

• Strong command of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads Editor, Shopify, Meta Business Suite, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including conversion tracking setups and offline conversion tracking

• Analytical, data-driven mindset, comfortable finding the “why” behind performance

• Understanding of e-commerce funnels and how paid media connects to revenue goals

• Ability to take a brand or product line from zero to one, building a paid strategy from the ground up

• Clear communicator who can explain performance and strategy to non-technical stakeholders

How the Two Roles Differ

Senior PPC Expert

• Has managed a team of PPC or performance marketers, or at minimum worked within a performance marketing team reporting to a lead

• Guides and mentors the PPC team: reviews campaign builds, shares best practices, and sets account standards

PPC Expert (Mid-Level)

• Hands-on optimizer who fully owns campaign performance: bids, budgets, search terms, audiences, and creatives

• Team management experience is not required

Key Responsibilities

• Plan, execute, and optimize PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Bing Ads, and other channels for North America and Europe

• Own budget allocation and bidding strategy to hit ROAS / CPA / CAC targets

• Drive keyword research, audience segmentation, and ad copy and creative testing

• Run day-to-day optimization: search term reviews, negative keywords, bid and budget adjustments, and audience refinement

• Manage conversion tracking, pixels, and tagging (GA4, GTM, Shopify, Meta Pixel/CAPI, LinkedIn Insight Tag), including offline conversion tracking

• Partner with the design and content team on ad creatives and landing pages, and run structured A/B tests

• Identify and pilot new paid channels such as Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, and TikTok Ads

• Take paid strategy from zero to one for new product lines and markets

• Build and present performance reports and dashboards to leadership

• Stay ahead of platform updates, bidding algorithm changes, and industry best practices

Nice to Have

• B2B lead generation and marketing funnel experience

• Familiarity with Semrush, Microsoft Clarity, and similar attribution/analytics platforms

• Experience with email marketing and WhatsApp marketing tools

title: Human Resources Generalist

description:

* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files and HR documentation.
* Monitor attendance, leave, weekly offs, shifts and other HR-related processes.
* Ensure timely completion of probation reviews and performance-related processes.
* Coordinate day-to-day HR activities and provide support to employees and managers.

**Recruitment & Manpower Planning**

* Identify and anticipate manpower requirements in coordination with department heads.
* Manage recruitment activities for both staff and blue-collar positions.
* Source candidates through appropriate recruitment channels and conduct initial HR screenings.
* Coordinate interviews and follow up on recruitment progress.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and monitor recruitment efficiency and time-to-fill.
* Support manpower planning in line with business and operational needs.

**Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Act as the primary point of contact for employee queries, grievances and workplace concerns.
* Support managers in addressing employee-related issues and resolving conflicts.
* Conduct employee discussions and ensure appropriate follow-up actions.
* Coordinate disciplinary procedures, counselling and warning letters when required.
* Promote employee engagement, welfare and retention initiatives.
* Contribute to maintaining a positive and respectful working environment.

**Payroll & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure accurate and timely submission of payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, overtime and other applicable elements.
* Coordinate payroll-related activities with the relevant internal teams or external service providers.
* Monitor compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity and other relevant employment regulations.
* Maintain statutory records and ensure proper HR documentation.
* Coordinate with external consultants and government authorities when required.
* Support labour-law compliance and HR-related audits.

**Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Coordinate probation, confirmation and performance appraisal processes.
* Support managers in monitoring employee performance and development.
* Assist in defining and monitoring HR-related KPIs.
* Identify training and development needs in collaboration with department heads.
* Coordinate training activities and support employee skill development.

**HR Policies & Process Improvement**

* Implement and communicate company HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure employees and managers understand and follow applicable HR policies.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and operational efficiency.
* Maintain HR documentation and support internal and external audits.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of HR practices in line with business requirements.

**HR Reporting & Management Support**

* Maintain accurate HR databases and reporting tools.
* Prepare and monitor HR reports covering manpower, recruitment, attendance, absenteeism, attrition and other relevant indicators.
* Provide HR data and analysis to support management decision-making.
* Ensure timely and reliable HR reporting to management.

**Profile:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven experience in HR operations and generalist activities, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, employee lifecycle management, employee relations, performance management and HR administration.
* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity and applicable employment regulations.
* Experience in manpower planning, blue-collar recruitment, employee engagement and workforce management.

* Strong communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interact effectively with employees, managers and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office, HRMS and HR reporting tools, with the ability to analyse HR data and prepare management reports.
* A hands-on, organized and proactive approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

title: Engineer – Mechanical Design
description:

The role is expected to create innovative and efficient solutions that meet project requirements and environmental standards by analyzing and optimizing mechanical systems.

Executing the complete product design and development (Concept development & finalization, design calculation for tank sizes, defining process parameters - Aeration time, settling time, HRT, SRT, volume of air required, Tank Overflow calculation; Pipe sizing and discharge estimation using hand calculation or software, Sizing the filtration system & dosing requirements).
  
  
**Equipment Selection**
Select appropriate mechanical equipment and components based on project requirements and performance requirements. Evaluate and choose pumps, blowers, mixers, agitators, compressors and other mechanical devices suitable for water & waste water treatment applications.
  
  
**Process Optimization**

**Documentation**

**Operations Collaboration**
Shall provide support for procurement, installation and commissioning, collaborating with electrical, civil and environmental engineers to ensure seamless integration of mechanical systems with other plant components.
  
  

* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 3 to 5 years of experiences in water treatment industry for Product & Process design.

* Hands on experience in SolidWorks & AutoCAD. Exposure to SolidWorks pipe routing will be an added advantage.

title: SME-Claims HC
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a subject matter expert in health care claims with a focus on claims adjudication and regulatory compliance in a hybrid night shift work model. Apply deep knowledge of HIPAA rules and both provider and payer operations to resolve complex claim scenarios reduce leakage and improve accuracy. Collaborate across teams to enhance claim workflows that support better outcomes for members and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review and adjudicate complex health care claims with precision to ensure accurate payment decisions that align with payer policies and contractual terms while minimizing financial leakage and rework.
* Apply expert understanding of HIPAA regulations to safeguard member data throughout claims handling activities and to support compliant documentation that can withstand internal and external audits.
* Analyze claim patterns across provider and payer data to identify root causes of denials or delays and recommend targeted process improvements that enhance turnaround time and payment accuracy.
* Collaborate with operations teams in night shift hybrid model to resolve claim escalations in a timely manner and provide clear guidance that enables consistent decisions across the claims portfolio.
* Document detailed adjudication rationales in claim systems so that downstream teams and external stakeholders can easily understand the basis for payment or denial decisions.
* Partner with provider relations and payer business teams to clarify benefit designs coding rules and reimbursement methodologies so that complex claim scenarios are processed correctly the first time.
* Conduct quality reviews of processed claims to verify adherence to standard operating procedures and provide structured feedback that improves team accuracy and efficiency.
* Contribute subject matter input to updates of policies and procedures related to claims adjudication HIPAA compliance and provider payer workflows to keep documentation aligned with regulatory and business changes.
* Support training activities by explaining complex claim rules and provider payer scenarios in simple terms so that new team members can quickly become productive.
* Use claim processing tools and reporting dashboards to monitor night shift workloads and prioritize items that have high financial impact or customer sensitivity.
* Engage with business analysts and technology teams to validate system configuration changes that affect claims adjudication and to highlight potential risks before deployment.
* Provide insights from day to day claim handling that guide product and benefit design improvements which improve member experience and reduce unnecessary provider friction.
* Coordinate with customer service teams to supply clear claim level explanations that help reduce repeat inquiries and support a more transparent experience for members providers and payer partners.

**Qualifications**

* Possess proven experience in health care claims adjudication with at least three years handling end to end processing of medical or hospital claims in a provider and payer context.
* Demonstrate strong practical knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as applied to real world claims workflows documentation practices and system usage.
* Bring hands on exposure to both provider side and payer side environments enabling balanced decision making that respects contractual terms network rules and member benefits.
* Exhibit proficiency with common claim platforms spreadsheets and reporting tools to research complex cases validate calculations and summarize findings for stakeholders.
* Show excellent written and verbal communication skills that support clear explanations of claim outcomes and effective collaboration across distributed hybrid teams.
* Display strong analytical and problem solving abilities with attention to detail that ensures accurate handling of high volume claims under night shift timelines.
* Adapt comfortably to a hybrid work model and night shift schedule while maintaining consistent productivity quality standards and responsiveness to team needs.

Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Security Consultant – Email Security, Data Access Governance to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including secure email gateway, data access governance and preferably, data leakage prevention. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Secure Email Gateway (Proofpoint, Microsoft)**

* Configuration Management: Setup and tuning of anti-spam, anti-phishing, and malware policies
* Content filtering, DLP, and encryption configuration Identity integration (e.g., Azure AD, LDAP)
* Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor email traffic and threat statistics. Generate regular reports (spam, phishing, malware, top targets)
* Policy Review & Optimization: Periodic tuning of SEG rules and threat policies. Maintain blocklists/allowlists. Update impersonation protection and VIP rules
* Integration Activities: SIEM/SOAR integration for logs and alerts, Threat intelligence feed integration, Hybrid/coexistence mail routing support
* User & Admin Support: Support for quarantine release, allow/block requests, Troubleshoot delivery issues, Phishing awareness collaboration
* Platform Maintenance: Patch management and availability monitoring, License tracking and capacity planning, Vendor support coordination (Proofpoint, Microsoft)

**Data Access Governance (Varonis)**

* Permissions Mapping: Map and analyse access rights, Detect over-permissive access
* Activity Monitoring: Track user behaviour and file activity, Audit file access, changes, deletions
* Access Governance: Support access reviews and least privilege enforcement, automate entitlement reviews, identify unused permissions

**Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**

* Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
* Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
* Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
* Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.

**Consulting & Delivery**

* Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
* Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
* Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong hands-on experience with Proofpoint Email SEG, Microsoft Exchange Online Protection, Varonis Data Access Governance
* Expertise is good to have in:

+ Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Compliance Centre and Microsoft Purview Portal.
* Understanding of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, and data privacy requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud security and Microsoft 365 architecture.

**Professional Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into security controls and governance policies.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Consulting mindset with client-facing experience.

title: Market Research Executive
description:
**Executive – Market Research**

**Location:**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Reporting To:**
Sales/BD In-charge

**Experience:**
0-3 yrs preferred; freshers with strong skills considered

**Languages Required:**
Fluent English plus anyone (Hindi / Tamil / Malayalam)

**Education:**
Bachelor/Master degree (Agribusiness, Food Technology, Marketing or related field)

**Why This Role Exists**

Before a sale can happen, someone has to find the right company, the right person to talk to and start that first conversation. This role is that first step - researching and identifying genuine leads, reaching out, understanding what a prospect needs and handing over only the ones worth pursuing. Done well, it means the Sales/BD team spends its time closing real opportunities, not chasing dead ends.

**What You'll Be Doing**

• Research and identify qualified leads through Google/web search, LinkedIn, and industry portals.

• Build and maintain an accurate, updated database of prospective clients and contacts.

• Reach out to prospects by call, email and LinkedIn to introduce Mevive and gauge interest.

• Understand a prospect's initial requirements and qualify whether it's a genuine, worthwhile opportunity.

• Record interactions, lead status and follow-ups and hand over qualified leads to the Sales/BD team.

• Handle a steady volume of outbound calls and follow-ups, managing multiple conversations at once.

• Track your numbers and share regular reports on leads generated, calls made and conversions handed over.

**What We're Looking For**

• Bachelor/Master degree (Agribusiness, Food Technology, Marketing or related field); freshers with strong communication and research skills are welcome.

• 0–3 years in market research, lead generation, inside sales or telecalling preferred - not mandatory for the right fresher.

• Excellent English and anyone language (Hindi / Tamil / Malayalam) communication skills.

• Comfortable researching online - LinkedIn, Google, supplier platforms, industry portals.

• Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and CRM or lead-management tools.

• Confident on the phone, comfortable with high call volumes and repeated follow-ups.

• Self-motivated, organised and comfortable working toward targets - not put off by rejection.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:

We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to serve as the primary system administrator for our Salesforce.com environment. description:
**We’re Hiring: Metallurgy Engineer – Material Testing & Quality Assurance**

**Company:**
V R Engineering

**Experience:**
5–10 Years

**Location:**
Irugur, Coimbatore

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About V R Engineering**

V R Engineering specializes in precision-engineered components, including keys, nuts, and machined parts, serving industrial customers in India and international markets. We are looking for an experienced Metallurgy Engineer to strengthen our material testing, chemical analysis, and quality assurance capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **OES Spectrometer Operation:**
  Independently operate, calibrate, and troubleshoot spark Optical Emission Spectrometers (OES) for chemical composition analysis of ferrous and non-ferrous metals.
* **Material Identification:**
  Verify grades of carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel, free-cutting steel, tool steel, die steel, cast iron, aluminium alloys, copper alloys, and nickel alloys.
* **Hardness Testing:**
  Perform Rockwell, Brinell, and Vickers hardness testing and interpret results against specified acceptance limits.
* **Report Generation & Analysis:**
  Independently prepare chemical composition reports, hardness test reports, and material verification reports. Compare results against material specifications, identify deviations, and determine conformity.
* **Material Quality Assurance:**
  Review Material Test Certificates (MTCs), supplier reports, and customer specifications to ensure material compliance.
* **Metallurgical Evaluation:**
  Support investigations into material defects, heat treatment issues, abnormal hardness, and machining-related material problems.
* **Laboratory Management:**
  Maintain testing equipment, calibration records, standard operating procedures, and material traceability.
* **Quality Improvement:**
  Collaborate with production, quality, and purchasing teams to resolve material-related non-conformances and support root cause analysis.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline.
* **5–10 years of relevant experience**
  in metallurgy, material testing, or quality assurance in machining or metal manufacturing.
* **Mandatory hands-on experience with spark OES spectrometers**
  , including sample preparation, analytical program selection, result validation, and troubleshooting.
* Practical experience testing both ferrous and non-ferrous alloys.
* Experience in Case Carburising, Hardening and Nitriding is preferred.
* Experience in NABL, BIS Laboratory certifications and ISO audit is preferred.
* Hands-on proficiency with Rockwell, Brinell, and Vickers hardness testers and Microstructure analysis.
* Ability to independently generate and analyze technical reports using required softwares , Microsoft Excel or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of material grades, chemical composition limits, ASTM/ISO/EN/SAE standards, and Material Test Certificates.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of metallography, heat treatment, microstructure analysis, and material failure investigation.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 and laboratory calibration and quality practices.
* Experience with supplier quality, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates with strong practical experience in OES operation, hardness testing, and material analysis are invited to apply through LinkedIn or send their resumes to
**hr.vrengg@gmail.com**

**Join V R Engineering and contribute to strengthening material quality and testing capabilities in precision manufacturing.**

* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree

* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.

* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**

**Additional Notes**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. Collaborate with delivery to identify lead learning partners and technical mentors to facilitate the training for Interns. Prepare and present periodic reports, dashboards, and insights for leadership and stakeholders. Ensure documentation, standardization, and continuous refinement of internship processes.

title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Windows
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

**Job Description**

5+ years managing compute infrastructure with strong focus on Microsoft technologies.

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: GENERAL MANAGER – AURAWILL BUSINESS
description:
We're Hiring: General Manager – Aurawill

📍 Location: Coimbatore

🏢 Full-time | On-site

Aurawill is one of India's fastest-growing nutrition brands, making traditional, science-backed nutrition simple and accessible for modern families.

In just over a year, we've earned the trust of 1,00,000+ customers and are expanding rapidly across D2C, marketplaces, quick-commerce and retail.

Aurawill is looking for a strong commercial General Manager to own the Brand’s business end-to-end and take responsibility for scaling the brand profitably. This role is for someone who is ready to own the full business rather than a single functional vertical.

The Opportunity

Aurawill is a natural health foods brand with an ambition to build a differentiated, trusted and scalable consumer business. The General Manager will be responsible for translating the brand ambition into business growth i.e owning the P&L, shaping strategy, setting priorities and leading the teams and functions required to deliver the plan.

What You Will Own

**P&L and Business Strategy:**
Own the overall Aurawill P&L and business plan; set revenue, gross margin, contribution, profitability and growth priorities; identify the biggest business levers and allocate resources and budgets accordingly.

**Sales channels:**
Own the D2C channel and other online/offline channels of business end-to-end including acquisition, retention, and channel profitability. Build a scalable growth engine rather than optimising only for topline.

**Marketing & Brand:**
Partner closely with the marketing team to translate the brand strategy into consumer growth. Own the commercial outcomes of marketing investments while protecting long-term brand equity, positioning and consumer relevance.

**Supply Chain & Operations:**
Own the operating rhythm from demand planning and procurement through production, inventory, fulfilment, quality and customer experience.

**Finance & Business Management:**
Work closely with finance to build budgets, forecasts, monthly business reviews, scenario building and investment cases.

**People & Organisation:**
Lead and align cross-functional teams across sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, operations and other business-critical functions. Build a high-accountability culture with clear goals, ownership and operating cadence.

**Growth & Innovation:**
Identify new consumer needs, occasions, products, channels and partnerships that can materially expand the business.

What We Are Looking For

Owned a D2C business, category, brand, business unit with full P&L responsibility.

Strong general-management orientation: able to lead revenue, margins, operations and people rather than operating only within one function.

Demonstrated ownership of business numbers and comfort being accountable for revenue, gross margin, contribution and profitability.

Strong understanding of D2C growth & metrics - acquisition, conversion, retention, repeat, CAC, blended CAC, LTV, AOV & Channel mix.

Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across marketing, sales, supply chain, finance and operations.

Strong commercial judgement: able to distinguish between growth that creates value and growth that merely creates topline.

Comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment with hands on experience where resources and budgets are tight

Data-fluent and financially rigorous, while retaining strong instinct for consumer and market.

High ownership, speed of decision-making and willingness to execute when needed.

A Tamil Speaking professional, preferably who lives in Tamil Nadu

Ideal Background:

We are interested in candidates who may currently be working as a D2C / E-commerce lead, Category Head, Growth Head, India Market lead or an equivalent role in a consumer business.

Minimum 5-6 years of relevant experience from D2C-first consumer brands, FMCG, food & beverage, health & wellness, beauty & personal care, nutrition, consumer tech or other categories where the candidate has had genuine commercial ownership and proven cross-functional leadership for a few years.

Entreprenuers who have built and scaled consumer businesses in the past are also welcome to apply.

*Preferred but not mandatory:*
From Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school in India

What you will get from us:

* Complete ownership and responsibility of business coupled with people leadership responsibility for a new-age brand that wants to build strong equity in the foods and nutrition business
* Freedom to experiment and decision-making autonomy
* A company with humble-people with good intention and make good quality products that serve consumer health

The right candidate:

This role is for someone who wants to build a business, not simply manage a function; be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and be willing to take ownership when something is not working.

Must be able to hold the energy & range to discuss brand positioning in the morning, review a P&L in the afternoon, challenge inventory assumptions, diagnose a D2C funnel and align a cross-functional team around the next growth priority. The ability to zoom in and out is central to this role.

title: Pastry Chef
description:
**Company Description**
Merlis Hotels Coimbatore is a hospitality brand focused on delivering comfortable stays and memorable dining experiences to guests in the Coimbatore region. The hotel offers a range of modern amenities and is committed to high standards of service, cleanliness, and food quality. Its culinary team plays a key role in shaping the guest experience through thoughtfully crafted menus and attractive presentation. Merlis Hotels encourages a professional, inclusive work environment where team members can grow their skills and contribute to guest satisfaction.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Pastry Chef role based at Merlis Hotels in Coimbatore. The Pastry Chef is responsible for planning, preparing, and producing a variety of baked goods, desserts, and pastries that align with the hotel’s standards and guest expectations. Day-to-day tasks include creating and testing new recipes, managing daily production of cakes, breads, and specialty items, and ensuring consistent quality, taste, and presentation. The role involves overseeing ingredient preparation, maintaining hygiene and food safety standards, organizing storage and inventory for bakery items, and coordinating with the broader kitchen team for events, buffets, and à la carte service. The Pastry Chef also supports menu development, cost control, and may train and guide junior team members in pastry techniques.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Bakery and Baking skills, including preparation of breads, cakes, pastries, and desserts.
* Candidates should possess solid Food Preparation and Cooking skills, with an understanding of portioning, plating, and food safety practices.
* Candidates should possess well-rounded Culinary Skills, including flavor pairing, recipe development, and basic knowledge of international desserts.
* Formal culinary or bakery/pastry certification or diploma is highly beneficial.
* Prior experience in a hotel, resort, or professional bakery environment is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced kitchen setting.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as per hotel operational needs.
* Commitment to maintaining a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive workplace.

title: Associate Business and Delivery Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

Responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, preparing BRDs and wireframes, defining project scope, and supporting delivery planning through effort estimation, resource capacity planning, timeline preparation, and project cost breakdowns.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Gather, analyze, and validate client requirements through discussions and stakeholder meetings.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and wireframes.
* Conduct client scoping discussions to define project features, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, and scope exclusions.
* Translate business requirements into actionable tasks and coordinate with technical teams for feasibility assessment.
* Identify requirement gaps, risks, and dependencies before project execution.
* Estimate effort hours for design, development, testing, deployment, and other project activities in consultation with respective teams.
* Assess resource capacity, team availability, workload, and skill requirements for project allocation.
* Prepare project timelines, effort estimation sheets, resource allocation plans, and detailed cost breakdowns.
* Support proposal preparation by providing scope details, effort estimates, resource requirements, and delivery assumptions.
* Evaluate project feasibility against the proposed budget, available resources, and expected timelines.
* Coordinate with Business Development, Project Management, UI/UX, Development, and QA teams to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
* Facilitate the handover of approved requirements and scope from the pre-sales stage to the project execution team.
* Monitor planned versus actual effort hours and assist in identifying estimation variances and resource utilization issues.
* Track requirement changes and assess their impact on project scope, timelines, resources, and costs.
* Maintain project documentation, estimation trackers, requirement logs, meeting minutes, and stakeholder approvals.
* Provide regular updates on project scope, resource availability, estimation status, and potential delivery risks.
* Support project review meetings and recommend improvements to estimation accuracy and delivery planning.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, computer science, IT, engineering, or a related field.
* Understanding of Business Analysis, software development life cycle (SDLC), and project delivery processes.
* Knowledge of BRD preparation, wireframing, requirement gathering, and client scoping.
* Understanding of effort estimation, resource capacity planning, timelines, and project costing.
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Familiarity with Figma, Balsamiq, Zoho Projects, Jira, or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and coordination skills.
* Prior experience in business analysis, PMO, or project coordination is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of requirements documentation and project scope.
* Reliability of effort estimates, resource plans, and cost breakdowns.
* Timely completion of documentation and delivery planning.
* Effective stakeholder coordination and identification of delivery risks.

title: Robotics Machine Maintenance Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
The Robotics Machine Maintenance Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore. This role involves performing routine and corrective maintenance on robotic systems, CNC machines, and associated production equipment to ensure optimal performance and minimal downtime. The engineer will plan and execute preventive maintenance schedules, troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, and carry out repairs in coordination with production and engineering teams. Daily tasks include monitoring equipment health, calibrating and testing robots, maintaining documentation and maintenance logs, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives for reliability and safety. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement maintenance best practices, adhere to quality and environmental standards, and support the integration of new automation technologies.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Equipment Maintenance and Maintenance & Repair for robotics and CNC machinery.
* Candidates should possess solid Maintenance Engineering and Preventive Maintenance skills for production and automation equipment.
* Candidates should possess Electrical Maintenance skills, including troubleshooting drives, sensors, control panels, and industrial wiring.
* Relevant experience with industrial robots, CNC machines, and automated material handling systems in a manufacturing environment.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, maintenance manuals, and electrical/mechanical schematics.
* Knowledge of safety standards and best practices in heavy industrial and foundry operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to work in shifts and respond to breakdowns promptly.

title: Infrastructure Operations Lead
description:
**About the Company**

Techjays is an AI engineering and technology consulting firm with its headquarters in Menlo Park, California, and delivery teams in Coimbatore and Chennai, India.

We are setting up a managed operations team in India to support a US-based B2B SaaS CRM platform. The platform runs on physical servers in a colocation data center rather than on a public cloud such as AWS, Azure or GCP.

The data center provider handles hardware break-fix support, while our team owns day-to-day operations, including security and releases, infrastructure and platform administration, and SQL Server databases.

As the
**Lead – Infrastructure Security and Release Operations**

, you will own production environment security and the processes involved in deploying code to production. Your responsibilities will include patching and vulnerability remediation, access control management, security incident response, and planning and executing production releases in coordination with the client's engineering team.

This is a hands-on role reporting to the Manager, Infrastructure and Platform Operations. You will be directly involved in operational activities while establishing security and release runbooks and change management processes for the operations team.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Own security operations for the production environment, including patch management,

vulnerability scanning and remediation, and hardening of Windows and Linux servers.

● Manage firewall rules, VPN access, network segmentation and load balancer

configuration together with the infrastructure team.

● Administer identity and access: Active Directory, service accounts, MFA and privileged

access, with regular access reviews.

● Monitor security alerts and logs, triage incidents, lead the response and write

post-incident reports.

● Implement changes, roll back failed changes during planned maintenance slots.

● Coordinate with the data center provider on hardware failures and planned maintenance

that affect security or systems.

● Prepare evidence for security and compliance audits, and keep policies, runbooks and

the change log up to date.

● Take part in the on-call rotation and act as the escalation point for security and network

issues.

**Must-Have Requirements**

● 12+ years in infrastructure, systems or security operations, with at least 3 years owning

production releases or change management.

● Hands-on experience securing Windows Server environments and working knowledge of

Linux.

● Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable/Nessus or

Rapid7, and with patching at scale.

● Good understanding of networking and network security: TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs,

TLS certificates and load balancers.

● Scripting in PowerShell and/or Bash.

● Willing to work with regular overlap with PST business hours and to be part of an on-call

rotation.

● Clear written and spoken English for working directly with US-based teams.

**Experience**
- 12+ Years

**Location -**
Coimbatore / Hybrid

**Joining -**
Immediate / Within 30 Days

**Work Hours**
-Regular overlap with US Pacific (PST) business hours; on-call rotation

**Nice-to-Have**

● Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audits.

● Experience with a SIEM such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel or Elastic.

● Background in colocation or on-premises data center environments.

● Certifications such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CEH or Microsoft security

certifications.

● Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS products.

**What We Offer**

● Competitive compensation

● Paid holidays and flexible paid time off

● Medical insurance for self and family (up to ₹4 Lakhs per person)

● Casual dress code and flexible working environment

● Direct work with US-based engineering teams on a production SaaS platform

title: PATIENT CARE ASSISTANT
description:
**Overview**
**Patient Care Assistant, Neuroscience Unit**
**Full Time, 72 Hours Per Pay Period, Day Shift**
**Fort Sanders Regional Overview**
Fort Sanders Regional Medical Center is a 444-bed hospital recognized for pairing clinical expertise with advanced medical technology to deliver exceptional care. As a Joint Commission Comprehensive Stroke Center, we provide leading-edge treatment for stroke recovery. Our facility also offers specialized services in bariatric surgery, robotic surgery, minimally invasive spine procedures, and advanced orthopedic care.
  
  
Fort Sanders Regional is part of Covenant Health, East Tennessee’s largest nonprofit health system and a Becker’s “ Top 150 Places to Work in Healthcare .” Covenant Health includes nine hospitals and nearly 150 service locations, offering employees a comprehensive benefits package with tuition reimbursement, student loan assistance, certification bonuses, and leadership development programs.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Functions as a direct patient caregiver performing tasks to assist registered nurses. Performs hands-on care, assistance with ADL’s and specified technical tasks for a group of patients under the supervision of the Team Leader. May also function as a sitter for patients in need of full-time supervision in the hospital.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Take and record temperature, pulse, respiration rates, blood pressures, weights, heights, and intake-output measurements.
* Encourage patients to turn, cough, and take deep breaths and to use incentive spirometry as specified by Plan of Care.
* Ambulate, and assist patients in and out of bed, into wheelchairs and transport when necessary.
* Attends to nutritional needs of patient which may include distributing meal trays, feeding, filling and passing out water pitchers,
* Provides morning or evening care, which may include bed bath, oral hygiene, combing hair, back care, dressing patient, changing bed linen, cleaning over-bed table and bedside stand, straightening room, and other supportive care as needed.
* Empty drains, canisters, urine bags, bedpans and emesis basins and record intake and output.
* Assists in maintaining a safe environment, which may include reporting equipment that is out of order, appropriate handling of linen and storing of supplies.
* Provides general care such as positioning, lifting or turning patients; assisting in use of bedpan, urinal or commode; preoperative supportive care; and application/removal of abdominal binders or anti-embolism stockings and sequential compression devices.
* Empty & clean ostomy bag, per procedure.
* Collect urine, stool and sputum specimen as ordered.
* Perform tasks such as ROM, assist with ambulatory devices as specified by the patients' plan of care.
* Perform phlebotomy (requires additional training). To include correct labeling using two patient identifiers, maintenance of lab-draw supplies, rotating and restocking.
* Perform EKG (requires special training).
* Promptly answer patient call lights and respond to patient requests.
* Report significant changes in patients' condition to RN.
* Help to maintain clean and orderly patient and work environment.
* Employ all established infection control policies including standard precautions, transmission-based isolation precautions, OSHA standards, safety measures and proper body mechanics in performance of job.
* Document/maintain patient record as appropriate.
* Gathers equipment for O2 set up. Checks O2 for connection and proper placement.
* Checks for proper functioning of equipment at patient bedside
* Ambulate patients with oxygen.
* Set up suction equipment and check for proper function.
* Demonstrates knowledge and competency in providing for age-specific needs of the population served.
* Demonstrates ability to perform skills on the Nursing Assistant checklist.
* Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
* Must be trained and willing to function in a Sitter capacity for patients who need full-time supervision in the hospital.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Education:**
None specified; will accept any combination of formal education and/or prior work experience sufficient to demonstrate possession of the knowledge, skill and ability needed to perform the essential tasks of the job, typically such as would be equivalent to a high school diploma or GED. Preference may be given to individuals possessing a HS diploma or GED.
  
  
**Minimum Experience**
None
  
  
**Licensure Requirement**
CPR required

*Hydro Prokav Pumps India Pvt Ltd*

*Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Network Design & Build Engineering:
  
  

* Translate high-level architecture into detailed, deployable network designs (low-level designs)
* Build, plan, and validate new network configurations and capabilities across LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, and cloud environments
* Develop and maintain network diagrams, standards, and reusable design templates
* Contribute to capacity planning and scalability assessments

* Lead implementation of network solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and corporate standards
* Lab-test and pilot new network services, hardware, and policies prior to production rollout
* Execute network upgrades, migrations, and deployments with minimal business disruption
* Coordinate closely with architecture and modernization teams to ensure smooth handoffs

**Operations & Support**

* Troubleshoot complex network performance and connectivity issues across on-prem and remote environments
* Support and optimize remote access solutions including VPN and secure access technologies
* Manage build requests, implementation backlogs, and configuration changes
* Security & Compliance:
* Implement network security controls including firewalls, segmentation, and secure connectivity solutions
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies and industry standards
* Support vulnerability remediation, audits, and risk mitigation efforts

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Partner with cloud, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Participate in technical design discussions and reviews
* Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, procedures, and standards

**Success Metrics**

* Timely completion of network implementation plans
* Successful lab validation and pilot deployments
* Reduction in network-related incidents through proactive improvements
* Number of reusable design templates and standardized configurations developed

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 10+ years of experience in network engineering or infrastructure roles.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of core networking protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* Routing & switching: hands-on experience with OSPF, BGP, and enterprise routing/switching across Cisco and HPE platforms
* WAN technologies: experience with Cisco SD-WAN and traditional WAN architectures
* Wireless networking: experience with Aruba Wireless and enterprise Wi-Fi deployments, Wireless Surveys, troubleshooting complex wireless related issues.

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across complex, distributed network environment

* Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent (Routing & Switching, Enterprise, or Security)
* Experience with Cisco SD-WAN design, deployment, and operations in enterprise environments
* Exposure to Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks and secure access solutions (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA)
* Experience with network automation and scripting using tools such as Python or Ansible
* Familiarity with cloud-native security controls and advanced networking features in AWS and Azure
* Experience supporting large-scale, geographically distributed enterprise networks
* Exposure to load balancers, proxies, or application delivery technologies

* Wireless: Aruba Wireless solutions, Cisco Wireless.
* Security: Palo Alto firewalls, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), network segmentation and access control technologies

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – PROCUREMENT MANAGER

**Position:**
Procurement Manager

**Industry:**
Real Estate / Construction

**Department:**
Procurement / Purchase

**Experience:**
5–10 Years

**Location:**
Coimbatore

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Procurement Manager**
to manage the complete procurement process for our real estate and construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for sourcing materials, identifying reliable vendors, negotiating prices, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining cost efficiency without compromising quality.

Key Responsibilities1. Procurement & Purchase Management

* Plan and manage procurement of
  **construction materials, building materials, MEP items, finishing materials, tools, equipment, and office/site requirements**
  .
* Understand project requirements and prepare purchase plans based on project schedules.
* Raise and process purchase orders as per approved requirements.
* Ensure materials are available at the site as per project timelines.

2. Vendor Management

* Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and contractors.
* Maintain an updated vendor database and vendor performance records.
* Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate
  **price, payment terms, credit period, delivery schedules, and warranty terms**
  .
* Build long-term relationships with key suppliers.

3. Cost Control

* Ensure procurement is carried out at the
  **best possible price without compromising quality**
  .
* Conduct price comparisons and market surveys regularly.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings and bulk purchasing.
* Monitor material price fluctuations and advise management accordingly.
* Ensure purchases are within approved budgets.

4. Project & Site Coordination

* Coordinate with
  **Project Managers, Site Engineers, Civil Team, Accounts, Stores, and Management**
  to understand material requirements.
* Follow up with vendors for timely delivery to project sites.
* Resolve material shortages, delivery delays, quality issues, and replacement requirements.
* Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with project execution timelines.

5. Quality & Material Verification

* Coordinate with the technical/site team to ensure purchased materials meet required specifications and quality standards.
* Verify specifications, quantities, brands, and approved makes before placing orders.
* Coordinate replacement or return of defective or incorrect materials.

6. Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain proper records of
  **purchase orders, quotations, comparative statements, invoices, delivery challans, and vendor documents**
  .
* Prepare regular procurement status reports for management.
* Track pending purchase orders and deliveries.
* Maintain procurement MIS and cost comparison reports.
* Coordinate with Accounts for invoice verification and payment processing.

7. Inventory & Stock Coordination

* Coordinate with the Stores/Site team to monitor material availability.
* Avoid over-purchasing, material wastage, and unnecessary inventory.
* Monitor fast-moving and critical construction materials.
* Support proper planning of material requirements based on project progress.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
* Good knowledge of
  **real estate and construction materials**
  .
* Strong knowledge of local supplier and contractor markets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good analytical and cost-comparison skills.
* Strong follow-up and coordination abilities.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and procurement software/ERP.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and purchase requirements simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work under project deadlines.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in procurement/purchase in:

* Real Estate Companies
* Construction Companies
* Residential / Apartment Projects
* Commercial Projects
* Infrastructure Projects
* Builders & Developers

will be preferred.

Educational Qualification

**Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma**
in any relevant discipline.

Candidates with qualifications in
**Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or Business Administration**
will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Procurement cost savings
* On-time material delivery
* Vendor performance
* Purchase price variance
* Material availability at site
* Purchase order processing time
* Quality of materials received
* Reduction in procurement-related project delays
* Vendor development and negotiation effectiveness
* Compliance with approved procurement procedures

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be
**proactive, commercially aware, well-connected with suppliers, strong in negotiation, and capable of ensuring the right material reaches the right project at the right time and at the right cost.**

title: Lead-to-Customer Specialist
description:
Who we are

Cleomitra is an AI-powered CRM built for how growing businesses actually talk to their customers: on

WhatsApp, on calls, everywhere. WhatsApp Business API, IVR voice routing, smart automation,

bookings and billing, all in one place.

We're moving fast, and every new customer we win shapes what we build next.

The role

When a lead raises their hand, by booking a demo, starting a trial, or sending a WhatsApp message at

11 pm, you're the first one there. You get them excited and answer the tough questions. Then you turn

"just looking" into "where do I sign?"

You'll do it in English, in Hindi, and in Kannada, Telugu or Tamil, because our customers are regional

business owners who buy from people who speak their language.

What you'll own

• Win deals end to end. Turn trials, inbound leads and demos into paying subscribers. Hit your

monthly conversion targets, then beat them.

• Speak their language, literally. Pitch, negotiate and handle objections in whichever language

builds trust fastest.

• Run killer live demos. Show prospects how WhatsApp automation, shared inboxes and billing

tools fix their specific headaches.

• Own your pipeline. Keep it healthy, track every lead in the CRM (yes, we use our own product),

and forecast accurately.

• Be the voice of the market. Tell product and marketing what prospects love, what they push back

on, and what they wish existed. Your feedback shapes the roadmap.

You might be a fit if you…

• Have 2–5 years in B2B SaaS sales, inside sales, business development or client conversion

• Can point to real numbers: conversion rates, quotas crushed, revenue grown

• Speak English and Hindi fluently, plus at least one of Kannada, Telugu or Tamil

• Learn tech quickly and can explain an API integration in plain words

• Have a hunter mindset: target-driven, resilient, and energised by a fast pace

• Treat no "as" as "not yet".

What's in it for you

• Competitive base plus uncapped, performance-based conversion incentives

• Early-team impact, with room to grow as fast as you do

• Hands-on work with AI-driven SaaS that customers actually use daily

• A direct line to founders and product, with no layers of hierarchy

Sound like you?

Send us your résumé and one line about the best deal you ever closed. We read every one.

title: VMC Setter cum Operator
description:
**Company Description:**

ProCaliber Technologies is a manufacturing-focused organization that specializes in precision engineering and component production for industrial clients. The company emphasizes consistent quality, reliable delivery, and the use of advanced machinery to meet demanding technical requirements. ProCaliber Technologies values safety, continuous improvement, and adherence to industry standards in all operations. Team members are encouraged to develop their technical skills and contribute to process optimization. The work environment supports collaboration between operators, engineers, and supervisors to achieve high performance and customer satisfaction.

**Role Description:**
The VMC Setter cum Operator is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore.

* Set up and operate VMC machines for precision machining operations.
* Perform machine setting, fixture mounting, workpiece clamping, and job alignment.
* Set tools, tool offsets, work offsets, and coordinate systems as required.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and machining instructions.
* Understand and execute CNC programs, including basic program editing when required.
* Select appropriate cutting tools, inserts, speeds, feeds, and machining parameters.
* Monitor machining operations and ensure components are produced according to specifications.
* Inspect finished components using measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and bore gauges.
* Maintain dimensional accuracy and ensure components meet quality requirements.
* Identify machining defects, tool wear, and machine abnormalities, and take corrective action within the scope of responsibility.
* Coordinate with the production and quality teams to meet daily production targets.
* Maintain proper machine housekeeping and follow workplace safety procedures.
* Perform routine machine checks and report maintenance requirements.
* Maintain records of production, inspection results, and tool usage as required.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Hands-on experience in setting and operating VMC machines, including tool selection, workpiece clamping, and parameter setting.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, process sheets, and machining instructions, with strong understanding of tolerances and surface finishes.
* Proficiency in using measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other inspection tools for in-process and final checks.
* Knowledge of CNC basics, G & M codes, and VMC programming or editing, along with troubleshooting skills for machining issues.
* Awareness of shop-floor safety practices, 5S, and proper handling of tools, materials, and equipment.
* Minimum ITI/Diploma in Mechanical or related field; experience in precision or automotive component manufacturing is an advantage.
* Ability to work in shifts, meet production schedules, follow instructions, and collaborate effectively with team members and supervisors.
* Strong attention to detail, quality-focused mindset, and willingness to learn and adapt to new processes or technologies.
* Willingness to work collaboratively with the production team.

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume with ProCaliber Technologies.

description:

MADBLACKS Architectural Practice is a design-focused firm committed to delivering thoughtful, functional, and sustainable built environments. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accountability for deliverables.
* Ability to work on-site in Coimbatore and conduct regular site visits and client meetings as required.

title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer
description:
Ledvore is an Indian-Irish engineering company working with clients across Ireland, Europe and the US in automotive, medtech and industrial manufacturing. Our engineering hub is in Coimbatore.

**Please read before applying**

Strong spoken English is the primary requirement for this role. You will be on calls with European engineers daily, asking and answering technical questions directly. We need someone who has already worked in an English-speaking environment — with international clients, an overseas parent company, or a global team.

**The role**

We are hiring an Electrical Design Engineer dedicated to electrical schematics for special purpose machines and automation systems.

You will work alongside our client’s electrical lead, who will provide templates, BOMs and oversight. What we need from you is the ability to take that input and complete the schematics correctly and independently — reading component data sheets, chasing down the answers you need, and asking the right questions when something isn’t clear.

**What you’ll own**

* Complete electrical schematics in EPLAN Electric P8, from template and BOM through to issued drawings
* Reading and interpreting component data sheets drives, PLCs, safety relays, sensors, contactors, motor starters
* Panel layouts, terminal plans, cable schedules and wiring diagrams
* Device tagging, parts database and macro work to the client’s standards
* Generating and checking BOMs against the schematics
* Raising technical queries directly with the client’s engineers and closing them out

**What we need**

* Excellent spoken and written English, with proven experience working in an English-speaking environment
* 8–12 years in electrical schematic design for machines, panels or automation systems
* Strong EPLAN Electric P8. If your background is AutoCAD Electrical or SEE Electrical and you are confident converting, we will consider you
* Genuine data-sheet literacy — you can size and specify from a manufacturer datasheet without being walked through it
* Self-directed. You will have oversight, but nobody will be checking every line
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering

**Nice to have**

* IEC 60204-1 and machinery safety experience
* CE marking exposure
* Safety circuit design to ISO 13849 (e-stops, safety relays, PL ratings)
* VFD, servo drive and motor control schematics
* Experience with European clients or standards

**What you get**

* Direct client exposure — you speak to the engineers using your drawings
* Real ownership from day one
