title: telecaller
description:
**Company Description**
Four Space is a growing organization focused on delivering reliable, customer-centered services and solutions. The company values clear communication, professionalism, and strong relationships with its clients and partners. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, collaborate effectively, and contribute ideas to improve processes. Four Space offers opportunities to learn, develop skills, and build a long-term career in a supportive environment. The company is committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace where all employees are respected and treated fairly.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site telecaller role based in Bengaluru. The telecaller will handle inbound and outbound calls to prospective and existing customers, provide information about products or services, and respond to queries in a clear and courteous manner. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining call records, following up on leads, updating customer details in the system, and escalating complex issues to the appropriate team members when needed. The role also involves meeting call targets, adhering to call scripts and quality standards, and coordinating with sales or service teams to support conversions and customer satisfaction. The telecaller is expected to maintain a professional demeanor, respect privacy and data protection guidelines, and represent Four Space positively on every call.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to speak clearly and confidently over the phone.
* Candidates should possess basic computer literacy, including using CRM or call management tools, email, and spreadsheets for recording and tracking customer interactions.
* Candidates should possess customer service abilities such as problem-solving, empathy, patience, and handling objections or complaints professionally.
* Candidates should possess time management and organizational skills to manage high call volumes, follow up on leads, and meet daily and weekly targets.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in English and at least one additional regional language commonly used in Bengaluru (such as Kannada or Hindi).
* Candidates should possess a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and supervisors.
* Prior experience in telecalling, customer support, or sales (voice process) is beneficial but not mandatory; entry-level candidates with strong communication skills are encouraged to apply.
* A minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent qualification is required; further education in business, communications, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Operations Early Career Entry Program
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
Our
**Operations Early Career Entry Program is**
designed to develop graduates both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.. From day one you will be exploring collaborative and dynamic environment company culture, and you will receive:
  
  

* A structured learning and development program, specific job-related trainings, professional

development and soft skills trainings.
  
  

* A buddy who can offer you their experience, knowledge and guidance throughout your internship.
* Dedicated networking events for the Interns.
* Leadership and business-related sessions with Senior Management.
* Possibility to grow your professional network by joining an Employee Committees include Professional PWN, Families Network, Disability & Inclusion Network, Pride & Friends Network, Environmental Sustainability Network.

**Internship dates**
: January 2027 – July 2027
  
  
You must be available to participate in the program in person, starting from day one and for its full duration and
**you are required to work from the office 5 days a week.**
**Why this role is important to us**
Our Global Delivery Function helps our clients achieve better investment outcomes by serving as the foundation of our organization. We perform all operational functions required to produce the back and middle office products and services that clients have contracted with State Street to provide. Our services include custody, accounting, fund administration, transfer agency, middle office and cash processing services for asset managers, asset owners, alternative investors and insurance companies across the full range of asset classes.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
As an Intern you will be part of any one of the below department State Street is catering:
  
  
**Fund Accountant**
The Fund Accountant is responsible for calculating the net asset values of funds by processing daily accounting related functions to ensure funds prices are accurate and delivered to the client in a timely fashion. The Fund Accountant is the central point of contact for all accounting support functions and analyzes the information received thereby ensuring any discrepancy is monitored and resolved professionally.
  
  
**Financial Reporting Specialist**
The Financial Reporting Accountant is responsible for preparing financial statements for annual and interim cycle. They also prepare and complete first draft of audited annual and un-audited interim financial statements from trial balance including Profit and Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Schedule of Investments notes to financial statements.
  
  
**Derivatives Specialist**
The team deals with the complex futures and options processing for the entire European exchange traded derivatives, Centre of Excellence book of business and supplementary business offshored from other State Street sites. The Derivatives Group is the central point of contact for the clearing banks and client service teams on all sites. Other services include some cash instructions and the improvement of processes for recording derivative instruments accurately and efficiently.
  
  
**Financial Accountant**
Financial Accountant performs the accounting processes that may include [but is not limited to]: accounting documents processing, journal processing, payments preparation, account reconciliation preparation and verification of the reports performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Treasury Accountant**
Treasury Accountant performs the treasury processes that may include [but is not limited to]: treasury transactions processing (money market stock market), prepare/approve payments, collateral management/margins, monitor minimum required reserve in national central bank, reconciliation bank accounts (cash positions balance sheet) reports, performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Transfer Agency Administrator**
Transfer Agency Administrator is responsible for trade processing, investor account maintenance, issue reporting and resolution. You will be responsible for processing investor transaction: review documentation to ensure anti-money laundering documentation has been received and enter subscription on ISS and save documentation on to DMS.
  
  
**Middle Office Administrator**
Middle Office Administrator is responsible for processing trade file submitted by the Fund daily on trade-date, trade-date confirmation (electronic telephonic or hard copy) based upon the trade file transmitted by the Fund and trade details provided by the Fund’s approved counter parties and monitor trade fails with prime brokers counter parties and the Fund including review of prime broker/custodian fail or mismatch of reports.
  
  
**Pricing Administrator**
Pricing Administrator’s role is to assist in the accurate and efficient pricing of a range of securities held by investment funds. The principal tasks of this role is to price exchange traded securities and validation to sources such as Bloomberg Reuters and FTID.
  
  
**Risk Analyst**
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) division within State Street Corporation establishes and maintains appropriate risk management policies guidelines and limits and assists executive and business-level management with minimizing operational credit legal regulatory reputation and other risks to the company.
  
  
**Compliance Analyst**
Investment Compliance Analyst will be responsible for monitoring compliance results on client portfolios related to Regulatory and Investment Manager (IM) mandates. Utilizing State Street’s Investment Compliance & Reporting platform the qualified candidate will complete the research analysis and reporting to ensure portfolios are in compliance with their investment restrictions.
  
  
**Data Management Analyst**
The Data Analyst(s) will be responsible to work comprehensively with both IT and the Investment Compliance/Market, Conformity Business Units to procure data necessary for daily compliance and conformity checks. Furthermore the Data Analyst will be responsible for the update and maintenance of market data, static data and holdings data that is not otherwise fed to the core application MIG 21 via automated data feeds.
  
  
**Anti-Money Laundering Specialist**
Anti-Money Laundering Specialist will be involved in reviewing investor Anti Money Laundering documentation in line with the AML policies and liaising with the Transfer Agency team’s in order to request and obtain the required data from the investors and/or clients.
  
  
****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving and decision-making skills.
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role.
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior.
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations.
* Desire to develop Your career in finance industry.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Basic knowledge in MS Office.

****Education & Preferred Qualifications****

* Final Year Students Enrolled in full time education at undergraduates in the penultimate year of degree in one of the following areas: Finance, Accounting, or Economics are preferred; applicants from other disciplines may also apply.
* Enthusiastic about building a long-term career in a dynamic organization.
* Effective communicators with the ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment.
* Open to feedback and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Motivated by real-world problem solving and eager to contribute innovative ideas.

****About State Street****
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance, and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.
  
  
State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.
  
  
Discover more information on India jobs at StateStreet.com/careers
  
  
****About State Street****
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: System Integrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a System Integrator with hands-on experience in network infrastructure implementation, integration, and troubleshooting. The candidate will be responsible for deploying and integrating network devices, switches, firewalls, load balancers, authentication systems, and monitoring solutions to ensure seamless connectivity, security, and high availability across enterprise environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement and integrate enterprise network infrastructure based on HLD and LLD documents.
* Install, configure, and integrate network switches and routers from Cisco, HPE, Aruba, and Juniper.
* Configure VLANs, Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, inter-VLAN routing, STP, VRRP, BGP, and link aggregation.
* Install and configure Fortinet FortiGate and SonicWALL firewalls, including security policies, firewall rules, and access controls.
* Configure and integrate F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancers, including virtual servers, pools, and health monitors.
* Integrate network devices with RADIUS/ISE authentication and SNMP-based monitoring platforms.
* Perform connectivity testing, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution during deployment.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal technical teams for implementation and system integration activities.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, application reachability, firewall, and routing issues.
* Monitor network performance and support incident management to maintain service availability.
* Prepare and maintain network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation plans, and SOPs.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, device replacements, and production deployment activities.

**Required Skills**

* 4–6 years of experience in System Integration, Network Engineering, or Infrastructure Implementation.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, LAN/WAN, routing, and switching.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco, HPE, Aruba, or Juniper networking equipment.
* Experience with Fortinet FortiGate or SonicWALL firewalls.
* Knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancing and high-availability concepts.
* Experience with BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP, and inter-VLAN routing.
* Familiarity with RADIUS/ISE, SNMP, SolarWinds, and Wireshark.
* Experience in network deployment, integration testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read network topology diagrams and HLD/LLD documentation.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge.
* Experience in enterprise network and security infrastructure integration.
* Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions.

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.

* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.

title: AI Evaluation Lead (Part Time Contract, Engagement Based)
description:
**About us**

DATACLAP is an AI data services company based in Coimbatore, working with AI companies across North America and Europe on data annotation, human in the loop workflows, RLHF and MLOps. We're building a dedicated AI evaluation practice covering LLMs, AI agents, computer vision and audio models, and we're looking for experienced practitioners to lead client engagements and mentor our engineering team.

**The role**

This is a part time, engagement based contract role, not full time employment. You'll lead AI evaluation projects for our clients, typically 8 to 15 hours a week per engagement. You'll design the evaluation approach, guide a team of junior engineers who do the hands on execution, review their work, and own the quality of what we deliver. You'll also help us turn every engagement into reusable methods, so the practice gets stronger with each project.

**What you'll do**

* Scope evaluation projects with clients: understand the model, the use case, and what "good" looks like for them
* Design evaluation frameworks, including metrics, test sets, rubrics, and pass/fail criteria
* Build or guide the building of golden datasets and evaluation harnesses
* Design and calibrate LLM as a judge setups, and know when human evaluation is needed instead
* Plan red teaming, safety and robustness testing where relevant
* Lead and mentor 2 to 5 junior engineers per engagement through regular reviews and working sessions
* Review results, catch flawed methodology, and present findings to client stakeholders
* Document each engagement as a playbook, rubric set or template the team can reuse

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in machine learning, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years focused on model evaluation, benchmarking or quality assurance of ML systems
* Hands on experience evaluating LLM applications: RAG systems, chatbots, agents or fine tuned models
* Solid grounding in evaluation fundamentals: metric selection, test set design, statistical significance, inter annotator agreement, and data leakage
* Experience with eval tooling such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, Inspect, Langfuse, Braintrust or EleutherAI's evaluation harness (or custom built equivalents)
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, and comfort reviewing others' work critically
* Clear written and spoken communication; you'll present findings to international clients
* Python proficiency

**Strong plus**

* Computer vision evaluation experience (detection, segmentation, tracking; metrics such as mAP and IoU; tools such as FiftyOne or CVAT)
* Audio or speech model evaluation (word error rate, speaker diarization, MOS style human ratings)
* Experience with AI agent evaluation: task completion, tool use, multi step trajectories
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF
* Prior consulting or client facing delivery experienc
  **e**

**Engagement mode**

* Contract basis, paid per engagement, with a monthly retainer during active projects
* Flexible hours, mostly remote, with occasional in person sessions in Coimbatore
* Start with a short paid pilot project so we can both see if it's a fit
* If you're currently employed, please make sure your employer permits outside consulting work

**How to app**
ly

Send us a short note (not just a CV) describing one model evaluation you designed or led: what you were evaluating, how you decided what to measure, and one thing that surprised you in the results.

**Company Description**

title: Independent Director
description:
**The Chair must understand what happens between the gate and the accounts**

This is a process-manufacturing mandate in which yield, grade, energy, water, effluent, maintenance, working capital and export execution all have financial consequences. The Board seeks a director capable of walking a plant, questioning the control design at source and later recognising the same issue in margin, provisions, cash flow and risk disclosure.

The dual chairship matters. Audit can identify recurring inventory, quality, safety or compliance issues; NRC must then ask whether accountabilities, capability, incentives and succession are helping or preventing durable correction. The director should resist the habit of treating people questions as separate from control quality.

**A plant-to-board agenda**

The first operating review should begin with material flow. The Chair will test purchase specifications, receipt controls, consumption norms, yield variance, rework, scrap, by-product accounting and finished-goods valuation. Variances should be understood by cause and recurrence, not merely absorbed into standard cost. Slow-moving and customer-specific inventory needs evidence-based provisioning.

The second lens is resource and process integrity. Water withdrawal, effluent treatment, emissions, chemical handling, energy intensity and waste are not solely ESG disclosures; they affect licence to operate, capital needs, contingent liability and customer acceptance. The committee should receive exceptions, near misses, consent conditions, monitoring reliability and closure evidence in a form that permits independent challenge.

Export and customer economics form the third lens. Foreign-exchange exposure, quality claims, shipment cut-off, rebates, customer concentration, logistics disruption and receivable recoverability should be reconciled to contract terms and cash. The Board needs to know when commercial accommodation becomes an accounting estimate or a conduct concern.

Maintenance and capex are the fourth. Deferred maintenance can flatter cash while increasing downtime, safety and quality risk. Each material capital project should have a baseline covering output, yield, resource intensity, safety and return; post-completion reviews should separate installation from realised benefit.

**NRC work that follows the evidence**

The appointee will lead succession planning for plant, commercial, finance and control leadership; review whether site-level managers can escalate bad news without penalty; and examine reward measures that may encourage volume at the expense of quality, resource compliance or working capital. A skills and dependency review should identify roles for which retirement, attrition or local knowledge loss would interrupt safe operation.

**The candidate**

Applicants may be manufacturing CFOs, plant or business heads, audit professionals, risk leaders or former chief executives with direct process-industry responsibility. They must show personal engagement with plant economics and control—not only corporate reporting. Experience of environmental compliance, export operations, labour-intensive sites or turnaround assurance is valuable. Previous Audit Committee chairship is preferred for the dual-chair role.

The appointment is conditional on independence checks, DIN and Independent Directors' Databank requirements. The Chair should expect site visits in addition to regular Board and committee meetings, with extra engagement around annual accounts, a material incident or leadership transition.

title: Content Team Lead
description:
**About Logbase**

Logbase builds a suite of apps that help Shopify merchants increase average order value and solve complex logistics problems. We serve 75,000+ merchants and are one of the fastest-growing companies in this space. We are moving upmarket toward larger Shopify Plus and Advanced merchants, and content is a big part of how those merchants find us, trust us and choose us.

**The role**

We are looking for a Content Lead to own the content engine end to end. That means content at every stage of the funnel, from website and landing pages and blogs that bring in merchants, to customer showcases that help larger merchants decide, to ebooks and whitepapers that go deeper. You will anchor the existing team, lead them to their success, and expand the team as needed with hiring or working with external flex teams, and report on what the content is actually delivering.

**What you will do**

* **Run the content engine.**

  Plan, produce and publish a steady mix of website and landing pages, blogs, customer showcases and case studies, ebooks and whitepapers, with a clear view of which piece serves which stage of the funnel.
* **Lead the team.**

  Manage content creators and freelance writers, set quality standards, review work and keep the calendar on track.
* **Scale with agencies.**

  Brief, manage and evaluate external content agencies so that volume grows without quality slipping.
* **Own the numbers.**

  Track performance for every content type, work out what is working and what is not, and share clear metrics and recommendations with management on a regular cadence.
* **Work across marketing.**

  Partner with Product Marketing on case studies and feature content, and with the wider team so content reflects how merchants actually talk about their problems.
* **Keep improving.**

  Use data to decide what to make more of, what to fix and what to stop.

**What you bring**

* 5 to 7 years of experience in content operations.
* Demonstrated experience running a content engine that produces a variety of formats across the funnel: website and landing pages, blogs, customer showcases, ebooks and whitepapers.
* Experience leading a team of content creators.
* Experience working with external agencies to scale content.
* An analytical mindset. You use data to understand what content works and what does not, and you can explain it plainly to management.
* Experience in B2B SaaS.
* Strong writing and editorial judgement.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Shopify or Shopify app SaaS. This is a big plus.

**What success looks like**

Content that is published on schedule, produced at a consistent quality, and tied to results that management can see. You will be expected to report on output and on the impact of that output, not only on volume.

**Location and relocation**

This is an in-office role at our Coimbatore office. If you are based elsewhere, we can help with relocation.

**How to apply**

Please include samples of your content with your application. Send work that shows the range of what you have run, such as a blog, a customer story and a longer piece like an ebook or whitepaper, and tell us which results you were accountable for.

title: Engineer - Test Maintenance
description:
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead the development, validation, and optimization of test programs for Flying Probe, ICT, FCT, Boundary Scan, and End-of-Line (EOL) test systems.

* Support production by providing timely resolution to tester-related issues and implementing Engineering Change Orders (ECO/ECN) in test programs.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, Work Instructions, validation reports, technical documentation, maintenance records, and calibration logs.
* Ensure compliance with IPC standards, customer requirements, ESD controls, safety regulations, and ISO quality management systems.
* Manage test engineering resources, project schedules, software licenses, fixtures, spares, consumables, and cost optimization initiatives.

title: Coding Specialist (Radiology)
description:

**Job Summary**

* The Coding Specialist is responsible for reviewing documents to identify all procedures and diagnosis. The Coding Specialist must ensure the encounters have been coded correctly based on documents received. The Coding Specialist should be able to communicate and recognize inadequate or incorrect documentation so that all coding is completed compliantly.

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early\-career to mid\-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer\-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production\-grade solution delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure, deploy, and support AI\-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP\-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
* Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
* Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
* Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.

* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.

* Strong troubleshooting mindset, structured communication, and comfort working in client\-facing delivery environments. Field engineering patterns from Microsoft and AI FDE patterns from the market both strongly emphasize technical depth plus customer communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, DSPM, CASB, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, encryption, or privacy engineering.
* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

* Typical work environment
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Incident management in multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure (on\-prem \+ cloud).
* Understanding of cloud\-native monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Operations Suite).
* Exposure to containerized platforms (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker).
* Familiarity with DevOps/SRE practices (CI/CD, automation, “observability as code”).
* Managing incidents in SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of cloud security, compliance, and governance impacts during incidents.


**What You’ll Do**
* Major Incident Leadership: Serve as the primary owner and decision\-maker for all high\-severity incidents, coordinating across multiple technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* End\-to\-End Incident Management: Manage the complete lifecycle of major incidents—from identification and logging to resolution and closure—ensuring adherence to SLAs and operational best practices.
* Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely, clear, and accurate updates to senior management, business leaders, and external stakeholders during critical incidents.

* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Guide and mentor Major Incident Managers, L2/L3 support teams, and other operational staff on effective incident handling and crisis management.
* Proactive Risk Management: Collaborate with monitoring, infrastructure, and cloud teams to identify potential service\-impacting risks and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Reporting \& Metrics: Maintain dashboards, KPIs, and metrics to track incident trends, team performance, and continuous service improvement.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5– 8 years of experience in IT operations, service management, or incident management roles, with significant exposure to major incident handling.
* Deep understanding of ITIL processes, especially incident, problem, change, and service continuity management.
* Proven experience managing high\-impact, enterprise\-wide incidents in complex, multi\-cloud or hybrid IT environments.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and crisis coordination skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities under high\-pressure situations.

title: Clinical Audiologist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Global Hearing Aid Centre is a consumer services company specializing in hearing care solutions, currently operating in Tamil Nadu, India. The organization focuses on providing diagnostic hearing services and hearing aid fittings for individuals with hearing and communication challenges. Team members work closely with clients to improve overall hearing health and quality of life through personalized care. The company values professionalism, ethical practice, and a client\-centered approach in all services offered.
 



**Role Description** 
 This full\-time on\-site Clinical Audiologist role is based in Chennai and involves providing comprehensive audiological services to clients of varied ages. Daily responsibilities include conducting hearing assessments, interpreting test results, and recommending appropriate treatment plans and hearing solutions. The Clinical Audiologist will perform hearing aid selection, fitting, programming, and follow\-up care, while maintaining accurate clinical records and documentation. The role also includes aural rehabilitation services, counseling clients and families on hearing health, and collaborating with other professionals to support speech and communication outcomes. The clinician is expected to follow evidence\-based practices, uphold regulatory standards, and contribute to continuous improvement of clinic processes and patient experience.
 



**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong clinical skills in Audiology and Hearing Aid Dispensing, including audiometric testing, hearing aid fitting, verification, and counseling.
* Experience in Speech and Speech Therapy to support communication development, including collaboration with speech\-language professionals when needed.
* Proficiency in Aural Rehabilitation, including auditory training, communication strategies, and patient education.
* Recognized degree in Audiology and Hearing (e.g., BASLP, MASLP, MSc Audiology or equivalent) from an accredited institution.
* Relevant professional registration or license as required by local regulations.
* Ability to communicate clearly and empathetically with clients and families, with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Comfort working in an on\-site clinical setting, with the ability to manage a steady caseload and work as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Prior experience in a hearing care clinic or hospital setting is an advantage.

title: AR Caller - RCM Healthcare
description:
**Company Description** 
 Wave Online LLC is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Health Information Management (HIMS) solutions for a wide range of healthcare providers, including medical billing companies, hospitals, faculty practices, ambulatory surgery centers, long\-term care facilities, and pharmacies. Since 1999, the company has focused on delivering high\-quality patient care documentation across multi\-specialty practices throughout the United States. Wave Online’s billing team offers deep expertise in end\-to\-end RCM, denial management and resolution, physician billing, accounts receivable recovery, and risk adjustment coding (HCC). The organization emphasizes professional services and revenue cycle assessments to help clients optimize financial performance and compliance. Team members join a stable, established company committed to operational excellence and long\-term client partnerships.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site AR Caller – RCM Healthcare role based in Coimbatore. The AR Caller will handle outbound and inbound calls to insurance companies to follow up on claims, verify claim status, and resolve denials or underpayments. Responsibilities include reviewing patient accounts, analyzing explanation of benefits (EOBs), updating account notes in the billing system, and coordinating with internal billing and coding teams to gather missing information. The role also involves ensuring timely collections on outstanding accounts receivable, escalating complex issues when necessary, and adhering to client\-specific guidelines and compliance standards. The AR Caller is expected to meet productivity and quality targets, maintain accurate documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement in the revenue cycle process.
 



  





**Candidate should have 1\+ years of experience in AR Caller.** 




  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle processes, including claims submission, A/R follow\-up, denial management, and basic medical billing concepts.
* Candidates should possess strong communication skills for interacting with insurance representatives and internal teams, including clear telephone etiquette and concise documentation abilities.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem\-solving skills to interpret EOBs, identify root causes of denials, and determine appropriate resolution steps.
* Candidates should possess computer proficiency, including working with billing software, CRM or practice management systems, and basic MS Office applications.

* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.

* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply**

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Senior Meta Ads Manager
description:
Concept Marketing is a Perth\-based digital marketing agency with 25\+ years of experience working across a broad range of Australian and international clients. We are looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager to join our offshore team, working closely with our Australian head office to plan, build, manage, and report on Meta advertising campaigns across the full client portfolio.
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on role. You will own Meta delivery from strategy through to execution. You will be expected to work independently, communicate clearly, diagnose problems across the full funnel, and apply instructions without needing them repeated.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 Campaign Strategy and Architecture
 


* Build, launch, and optimise Meta ad campaigns across Facebook and Instagram for multiple clients simultaneously
* Structure campaigns correctly from the ground up, including objectives, ad sets, audiences, placements, budgets, and bidding strategies
* Know when to consolidate campaigns versus segment them, and understand how Meta's auction and delivery system responds to structural decisions
* Use campaign budget optimisation versus ad set budget optimisation strategically, not by default
* Manage ad fatigue cycles and rotate creative proactively before performance drops
* Manage frequency intentionally across funnel stages
* Run all campaign types including lead generation, conversion, awareness, retargeting, and traffic



  





**Audience and Signal Strategy** 



* Build and maintain a clean, organised custom audience library across all client accounts
* Develop full\-funnel audience strategy including custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting segments, and exclusion logic
* Understand audience overlap and apply exclusion logic correctly
* Use value\-based lookalikes where purchase or lead quality data exists
* Know when broad targeting with strong creative outperforms narrow audience targeting, and test accordingly
* Understand Advantage\+ audiences and when to use or constrain them



  





**Tracking, Technical Setup, and Data Integrity** 



* Implement and verify the Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and custom events
* Configure Aggregated Event Measurement correctly post\-iOS 14
* Set up GA4 goals and conversion tracking and connect these to campaign reporting
* Maintain accurate and consistent UTM structures across all campaigns
* Troubleshoot tracking issues independently before escalating
* Understand the differences between Meta\-reported data, GA4 data, and actual CRM or backend conversions, and be able to explain the gap clearly
* Set up and interpret Meta Attribution Settings correctly based on business type and sales cycle
* Know the limitations of iOS 14\+ signal loss and apply practical responses including first\-party data strategy
* Identify when data is unreliable and flag it rather than report it as fact



  





**Ad Creative** 



* Brief designers and copywriters with enough specificity that the output is usable without rework
* Write ad copy that is direct, on\-brand, and built to convert
* Read creative performance data and identify whether an issue is the hook, the body, the CTA, the format, or the audience mismatch
* Understand the difference between a scroll\-stop problem and a conversion problem
* Structure creative testing with a clear hypothesis, not random variation
* Review creative performance and feed learnings back into briefing



  





**Problem Solving and Diagnosis** 



* Diagnose performance issues across the full funnel, from impression through to conversion, before escalating or reporting a problem
* Review landing pages before campaigns go live and flag conversion issues proactively
* Understand that a low conversion rate is not always a media problem and communicate clearly to the relevant team what needs to change and why
* Read client performance in the context of the business, not just the platform
* Factor in seasonality, sales cycles, and external variables when interpreting results
* Do not over\-claim credit for results or under\-explain causes of decline
* Surface issues early with context and a recommended next step, not just a notification that something is wrong



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare clear, accurate performance reports for the Australian team on a regular cadence
* Report against agreed KPIs including cost per lead, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and spend efficiency
* Present data with interpretation, not just numbers
* Flag anomalies and performance shifts proactively, not reactively



  





**Staying Current** 



* Keep up with Meta platform changes, new ad formats, and algorithm updates as they happen
* Test new features including Advantage\+, Advantage\+ creative, and AI\-driven tools with intent, not just because they are available
* Understand where Meta's automated tools perform well and where they need to be constrained or overridden



  





**Account Hygiene and Documentation** 



* Maintain clear naming conventions, account notes, and change logs so anyone can pick up an account and understand its history
* Document what has been tested, what worked, and what was ruled out
* Treat account hygiene as a non\-negotiable, not an optional extra



  





**Organic and Scheduled Social (Desirable)** 



* Support content scheduling and organic planning using tools such as Sked Social or equivalent
* Coordinate scheduling of content across client accounts in line with approved content calendars



  





**Communication and Collaboration** 



* Work directly with the Australian team via scheduled check\-ins and async communication
* Follow briefs and documented instructions accurately without requiring clarification on previously covered ground
* Ask the right questions upfront and then execute without hand\-holding
* Communicate issues early and clearly, with context and a recommended course of action



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Minimum 10\+ years of hands\-on Meta Ads experience managing multiple accounts simultaneously
* Strong technical knowledge of Ads Manager, Business Manager, Meta Events Manager, and Conversions API
* Solid understanding of GA4, conversion tracking, attribution, and UTM structure
* Experience with full\-funnel campaign strategy, audience architecture, and creative testing frameworks
* Ability to diagnose performance problems across media, creative, tracking, and landing page without being directed to do so
* Excellent written English communication skills
* High attention to detail across naming conventions, tracking, budgets, and reporting
* Proven ability to work independently within a remote team structure
* Experience working with or reporting to teams in a different time zone, ideally Australia



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience using Sked Social or a comparable scheduling platform
* Organic social content planning experience
* Agency environment experience managing multiple client accounts



  





**What We Expect From You** 




**This role requires someone who can read a brief, understand the objective, and execute correctly the first time. We document our processes, and we expect them to be followed. We give feedback once, and we expect it to be applied. If something is unclear, we expect you to ask before you start, not after you have finished.** 




**When something is not working, we expect you to investigate, form a view, and bring a recommendation. We do not expect perfection, but we do expect ownership. We are not looking for someone to be managed. We are looking for someone who manages their own work to a high standard, communicates when it matters, and makes the Australian team's job easier, not harder.** 




  





**Reporting Structure \& Team Interaction** 




**You will report to the Head of Digital Services. This is primarily a non\-client\-facing role, requiring close collaboration with the Digital \& Marketing Team in Perth and the digital and web team based in Coimbatore.** 




**Weekly Meetings and briefing sessions will be conducted, along with workflow and task updates through Monday.com. Training on Monday.com will be provided for seamless team integration.** 




  





**Work Location:** 




**This is a full\-time role (Monday–Friday) based in our Coimbatore office. As we collaborate closely with our Perth team, your working hours will be 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM IST to align with their schedule.** 




  





**To Apply** 




**Please submit your CV along with a summary covering:** 



* The Meta accounts you have managed and approximate monthly spend levels
* The types of campaigns you have run and the objectives they were built against
* Any tracking or technical setup work you have handled directly
* An example of a performance problem you identified and how you resolved it

description:
**P. Namperumalsamy Regional Research Center (PNRRC), Aravind Eye Hospital, Coimbatore** 




  




* **Qualification: MD (Microbiology) or PhD (Microbiology).**

* **Salary: Commensurate with qualification and experience**



  





**The role** 



* Aravind Eye Hospital, Coimbatore, is looking for a microbiologist to lead its Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology program at PNRRC. The position carries full responsibility for the diagnostic microbiology laboratory and for the molecular diagnostics research program.



**Diagnostic service** 



* Run the diagnostic microbiology laboratory serving a high\-volume tertiary eye hospital: microbial keratitis, endophthalmitis and ocular surface infections
* Maintain quality standards, standard operating procedures and turnaround times, and lead the laboratory towards accreditation
* Work closely with the cornea, retina and other clinical teams on result interpretation and difficult cases



**Molecular diagnostics** 



* Lead the molecular diagnostics program, which currently includes CRISPR/Cas12a\-based rapid pan\-fungal detection, PCR\-based pathogen identification and metagenomic sequencing on an in\-house Nanopore platform
* Take assays from development through optimization, analytical validation and clinical validation, and into routine use where warranted
* Contribute to the design and conduct of the ICMR\-funded multicentre program on molecular diagnosis of fungal endophthalmitis, and related work on infectious keratitis



**Research and training** 



* Design, conduct and publish studies drawing on the hospital's large clinical specimen base
* Contribute to grant applications and external collaborations
* Supervise technical staff and postgraduate trainees



**Essential** 



* MD (Microbiology) or PhD (Microbiology)
* Experience running, or working at a senior level in, a routine diagnostic microbiology laboratory
* Working knowledge of laboratory quality systems
* Ability to function as part of a clinical service and communicate with clinicians
* Demonstrated interest in research (publications, projects or grants)



**Desirable** 



* Molecular diagnostic assay development and validation
* PCR, sequencing (including Nanopore metagenomics)



**What Aravind offers** 



* A high\-volume tertiary eye hospital: the laboratory receives approximately 1000 ocular specimens a year
* An established molecular laboratory with real\-time PCR, a Nanopore sequencer, etc. and a team of 6 technical staff
* An ICMR\-funded multicentre program in molecular diagnostics for endophthalmitis, with assay validation and metagenomic sequencing under way
* Daily working contact between clinicians and researchers, and a research group with a record of publication in ocular infection and molecular diagnostics
* Support for research proposals, conference presentation and postgraduate supervision
* How to apply
* Send the following to siddharth@aravind.org with the subject line "Application: Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology":
* Curriculum vitae, including a list of publications
* A one\-page statement of research interests and relevant diagnostic laboratory experience
* Names and contact details of two referees

description:

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
 The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Lead the administration and advanced support of the CyberArk PAM solution, including complex troubleshooting, policy management, and platform optimization.
* Design and implement enhancements to the CyberArk infrastructure to improve security, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.
* Oversee the onboarding of new accounts, platforms, and integrations into the CyberArk environment, ensuring adherence to strict security guidelines.
* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to support enterprise\-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM\-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross\-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.
* Proven experience in managing complex CyberArk environments, including components such as EPV, CPM, PSM, and AIM.
* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi\-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Exposure to statistical process control, quality tools, and structured corrective\-action methodologies.
* Knowledge of welding, fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging processes for industrial equipment.


 Flowserve is a world\-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000\+ employees in 50\+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges themselves to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000\+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.

* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar HR leadership role, preferably in retail or multi\-location operations.

description:

**Staff, P\&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.
